străbus , a, um, adj. 1. strabo,
I.squinting: de Venere paetā strabam facit, Varr. ap. Prisc. p. 684 fin. P.; cf.: “strabones sunt strabi quos nunc dicimus,” Non. 27, 2 : straba foeditas, Cassiod. Orthogr. praef. p. 2278.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
